spans.s: 1. नृ—व॑त् ind. like men, strongly, richly, abundantly, RV.
2. नृ—व॑त् mfn. having men, belonging to or fit for or consisting of men &c., RV.
नृ—व॑त्—सखि (नृव॑त्-), mfn. (a sacrifice) having many associates who take part in it, ib.
नृ—वर m. best or chief of men, sovereign, king, Mudr.
नृ—वराह m. man-boar (Viṣṇu in his 3rd Avatāra), AgP.
नृ—वा॑हण or नृ—वा॑हस्, mfn. conveying men, RV.
नृ—वा॑हण or नृ—वा॑हस्, mfn. conveying men, RV.
नृ—विडम्ब mfn. imitating or representing a man, BhP.
नृ—वेष्टन m. ‘encircled with (the bones of) men’, N. of Śiva, L.
